sections.text: Introduction

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on an annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 as indicated in the title block.

The technical specification of trash rack cleaning 
machine main dia. 4120*3250*3840 mm, traveling speed 2.2/22m/s, lifting speed 
7m/s

The 
first draft is initiated, tested and approved by eng. Abd El Mohsen Mohammed 
general manager of

Nag 
Hamady hyd. PS
Safety Precautions

A work permit must be issued and qualified maintanance staff should carry the 
 suitable safty category
Safty fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Stop pump and switch off the power supply
Put suitable warning boards

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

Set of wrenches,
 Alignment equipment

Grease for lubricating,
 Cleaning material
Work to be Carried Out

Check up the crane during 
operation and review the lifting mechanism for trash rack cleaning machine

Check up the mechanical 
parts, rail, vibration test test the brake for the crane

Check up the oil level in 
reduction gear box, control and safety instrument

Check up the structure for 
the crane. Review the joints, rivits, welding and bolts

Check up the clean and 
grease the ropes, pulleys, and coupling
Operate the crane for test
